statement: Exhibit a connected triangle-free graph of order 12 with exactly 18 edges whose graph-distance matrix has exactly 4 distinct eigenvalues and whose Inverse Even value under the even_excludes_v reading is exactly 7/4. This is a second in-class target: it exists to demonstrate that the ADR-0082 activation admits any target validating against the exact-graph schema class, not one fixture file's hash. No claim of satisfiability is made or implied.
